column1: # vmq target list. Copy to ~/Library/Application Support/vmq/resources.tsv (or set VMQ_REGISTRY) and edit.

column2: <SSH address of the Mac the target is on>

column1: # The operating system is the one running inside the target (macOS, Windows, Linux), or - for a target with none (a build slot).
# A role names a group of targets: `vmq acquire @server` takes whichever target with role server is free first.
# `@server+@client` takes a server and a client on the same Mac (same second column).
# Build slots: the number of lines is how many builds may run at once (`vmq run @build -- make`).
